title: Austin et al. (2026), Venus Geospatial Raster Datasets

statements.text: Prepared by T. Austin et al. (2026). Observations: Ingalls et al. (1968); Saunders and Malin (1977); Campbell and Burns (1980); Pettengill et al. (1980); Campbell et al. (1984).
statements.scope: Five radar maps of Venus from 1967 to 1983, rescued from printed figures and archive mosaics and georeferenced to Magellan.

statements.text: Scans of printed figures keep their grid lines or annotations; positions can be 40 to 300 km from Magellan’s; brightness is the scan’s, not a calibrated echo strength.
